rules.text: AI extracts; deterministic services make money decisions.
No conclusion without provenance.
No fee before attributable cash is received.
No fee for equal-value prior recognition.
Uplift fee applies only to incremental collected value.
Evidence is immutable/versioned.
Baselines are immutable/versioned.
Scope validity ranges never overlap.
Every financial line is reproducible.
Currency is never silent.
Rounding is versioned.
Tax is versioned.
Missing pricing fails closed.
Human approval is default.
Automation is explicit and policy-bound.
Dry run exists.
Postgres owns business state.
S3 owns binary evidence.
NATS is transport only.
Rust core is stateless and pure.
Vendor semantics terminate at adapters.
Durable inbox is required.
Transactional outbox is required.
Outbox leases are required.
Dead-letter state is explicit.
Tenant-aware composite FKs are required.
RLS uses internal organization UUID.
Runtime roles may not bypass RLS.
Allocation ceiling is enforced.
Payment reductions revalidate allocations.
Verification-only success fee is zero.
Electrical construction is the MVP vertical.
Collections are outside MVP.
Market benchmarking is outside MVP.
Golden financial values serialize as decimal strings.
IEEE-754 is forbidden at deterministic financial boundaries.
Full semantic equality is asserted before hash equality.
Canonical JSON version is pinned.
Fixture constants are not hardcoded into engine logic.
Valid no-opportunity decisions are not errors.
AI outage retains source evidence and deterministic state.
Same inputs yield the same evaluation.
Pilot precision is more important than recall.
Locked invariant changes require explicit spec revision.
Evidence Ledger is the primary UI theme.
Blacksite is a counterpart, not the primary app look.
AI is never the principal visual actor.
No opaque combined confidence score.
Every significant financial number must be inspectable to provenance.
Status may not depend on color alone.
Desktop, tablet, and phone layouts are intentional.
Server is authoritative for recovery evaluations.
Offline clients cannot create authoritative recovery determinations.
Offline actions are queued and revalidated before execution.
Native clients use secure OS credential stores.
Confidential contract detail is hidden from lock-screen notifications by default.
Web and Tauri clients share one component/token system.
iPad is a first-class field-review target.
Windows `.exe` is the first installed-client launch.
Canonical governance text is not runtime authority without enforcement binding.
Application services cannot create authority that contradicts Anar-Core.
Privileged decisions emit decision receipts.
Governance readiness requires executable proof.
Canonical metadata/body status may not conflict.
Secret references are not secrets.
Secret references are not authorization.
Vault resolution requires separate identity/authority/purpose validation.
Secrets never enter deterministic recovery core.
Cloudflare is a defense layer, not the sole security boundary.
Governance permanence does not imply customer-data permanence.
Customer data is not used for general-purpose model training by default.
External AI access is minimized, governed, and version-attributed.
Post-termination export window is 30 days.
Ordinary backups age out within 90 days.
PostgreSQL RPO target is ≤15 minutes.
Core RTO target is ≤4 hours.
Pilot/early access carries no service-credit SLA.
Kansas law/venue govern launch contracts.
MSA + Order Form is the launch contract structure.
Success-fee disputes have a 30-day dispute window.
Selected Recoveries mark is the Recovery Gate / Delta-Shard hybrid only.
Rejected logo branches are not part of the design system.
External side effects are visually explicit.
Action payload mutation invalidates approval.
Executor never regenerates business logic.
Secret broker workers are governed by Anar-Core.
Client-native Rust is not a second recovery authority.
All customer-facing policy promises must match actual implementation.
Retention is a lifecycle policy, not “keep everything.”
Legal, privacy, security, policy, architecture, and runtime definitions must use the same financial/attribution vocabulary.
